office_does: The county clerk keeps Klickitat County Superior Court's case records and filings and manages juries.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Clerk Renea Campbell (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2014, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Klickitat County Clerk since 2014 and a former East District Court administrator; the only candidate.
highlights: Introduced electronic filing and a new case management system [S1]
24 years at East District Court before that [S1]
